summary: Zuma entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Zuma
entries.definitive_edition: Zuma Deluxe on Windows PC with compatibility state documented

emulation.notes: Use native PC route; emulate only for console/mobile comparison.

primary.version: Zuma Deluxe on Steam, with known fixes available.
primary.why: The current Steam Zuma Deluxe route is the most accessible PC version of the original PopCap game. Console and mobile versions are useful history, but no sourced exclusive story or level content forces a second playthrough.
primary.how_to_play: Use Zuma Deluxe on Steam or a verified PopCap PC release. Record storefront/build, OS, compatibility mode, resolution/fullscreen behavior, 3D acceleration state, input device, and whether any console version was compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only for release-history or control comparison.
secondary.why: The PC Deluxe route is the cleanest main archive target.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record compatibility mode and display behavior; avoid confusing Zuma with Zuma's Revenge!, which is a sequel.
